label: Bible Study
prompt: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is _____, being alone.
verse: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
note: James at his bluntest — faith without works isn't resting, it's dead.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: My sheep hear my _____, and I know them, and they follow me:
verse: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
note: Sheep know their shepherd by sound, not sight — and Jesus says His know His voice the same way.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a _____ unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verse: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
note: Israel crossed the Red Sea on dry ground, the waters standing as a wall on their right hand and on their left.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the _____ of life.
verse: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
note: 'Issues' means outflows — the heart is the wellhead, and everything downstream tastes like it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Be sober, be _____; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
verse: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
note: 'Be sober, be vigilant' — written by Peter, who once fell asleep in Gethsemane when told to watch.
